function use(
	items: number[],
	operation: (item: number) => Promise<void>,
	width: number,
) {
	const serial = 1;
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	mapLimit(items, 1, operation);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit(items, { width: 1 }, operation);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	mapLimit(items, serial, operation);
	mapLimit(items, 4, operation);
	mapLimit(items, { width: 4 }, operation);
	mapLimit(items, width, operation);
}
